scope: Independent arithmetic checks of the source-only mixed enrichment algebra helper. No MLS, provider, stiffness assembly, solver, or physical fracture behavior.

predeclared_tolerances.threshold_policy: Do not change thresholds after observing output; any failed check is reported for review.

planned_checks.name: off_cut_central_differences
planned_checks.acceptance: At one off-cut center and six +/- world-coordinate perturbations, central differences independently match all four branch gradients and all four N*F product-rule gradients; N is varied affinely with the perturbed coordinate.

planned_checks.name: proper_frame_rotation_covariance
planned_checks.acceptance: Under one non-axis-aligned proper Q, branch values are invariant and all branch and enriched world gradients transform by Q.

planned_checks.name: radial_homogeneity
planned_checks.acceptance: At fixed angle with r scaled by four, each branch value doubles and each analytic gradient halves.

planned_checks.name: direct_symmetric_gradient_B_columns
planned_checks.acceptance: Every emitted ux, uy, uz B column matches an independently formed displacement-gradient tensor, symmetric strain tensor, and engineering Voigt order [xx, yy, zz, gamma_xy, gamma_yz, gamma_xz]. Reuses central-difference center row.

planned_checks.name: paired_permutation_and_27_source_semantic_inventory
planned_checks.sources: 2 for paired permutation; 27 once for semantic inventory only
planned_checks.acceptance: Paired source-row permutation preserves sorted semantic IDs and contribution records. The 27-source row contains the exact expected set of 405 distinct source/component/base-or-branch IDs, not only a count-function result.

planned_checks.name: front_cut_and_explicit_traces
planned_checks.acceptance: r=0 and an unselected local crack face return their UNKNOWN statuses with no partial rows; exact upper and lower local face traces both return complete rows with theta = +/-pi.

planned_checks.name: improper_frame_and_nonfinite_rejection
planned_checks.acceptance: A determinant-negative frame and a NaN base value are rejected with the helper's documented input errors. Reuses the central-difference center coordinate.
